credits.title: Funeral for a Sheep
credits.overview: Fionn lives with his dad and grandma in a small Irish village. When one of the family's sheep dies, Fionn is determined to bury it. He even skips school to do so. His grandma turns a blind eye for once. She knows that today is a particularly difficult day for Fionn.

credits.title: An Irish Goodbye
credits.overview: A disconsolate man draws comparisons to this when he struggles to write a suicide note for his parents. Through a melancholy yet humorous monologue, he criticises and provides observations on contemporary Irish youth culture.
